_meta.description: More Map Variations chr imports â€” cross-game boss ports. REQUIRES the MMV mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/eldenringnightreign/mods/578) installed in your me3 profile. Without MMV's regulation + chr assets, enabling this will cause CTDs because the rando will reference chrs that don't exist in your active regulation.
_meta.enable_instructions: If you have MMV installed: set _meta.enabled=true and run normally. The 13 c-prefixes in blacklist_when_active are blocked because they CTD or have missing assets even WITH MMV â€” leave them. If you don't have MMV: leave _meta.enabled=false. The rando will run on vanilla NR + DLC content only.
_meta.requires: MMV mod installed in me3 profile

blacklist_when_active._note: When mmv_imports._meta.enabled=true, ALL c-prefixes in all three lists are added to V3_EXCLUDE_TARGET_PREFIXES at load_data time. Disabling MMV (set _meta.enabled=false) removes the blacklist â€” appropriate when running vanilla NR regulation where DLC chrs are functional and MMV chrs don't exist. v0.23.39: c8500 Manus added (DS1, asset graph too divergent). v0.23.46: c8300 Dragonslayer Armor was initially added â€” CTD with access violation (memory write to NULL+0x24) reported. LATER VINDICATED in subsequent playtest: works fine when properly slotted, original CTD attribution was incorrect. Removed from blacklist. v0.23.55: c4720 Godfrey was initially added â€” CTD on Castle approach (seed 961158) reported. LATER VINDICATED in subsequent playtest: works fine. Removed from blacklist. v0.23.72: new ai_broken category added for MMV imports whose AI behaves unreliably even though chrbnd/anibnd load cleanly (no CTD, no asset miss â€” just busted combat behavior). c5840 Black Knight added (DS3 port, MMV import) â€” AI unreliable in field placements. Parallels V3_HERITAGE_AI_KNOWN_ISSUES on the heritage side but uses full exclusion rather than SENSITIVE-only restriction. v0.23.72-late: user playtest sweep of MMV chrs near m60_43_37_20 encampment (Sentient Pest seed 35300). c5840 Black Knight escalated from ai_broken â†’ ctd_unidentified after confirmed CTD encountered in field. c5880 Catacombs Sorcerer (DS3 import) added to ctd_unidentified â€” CTD on encounter. c6201 Scarab (ER import) added to ctd_unidentified â€” CTD on encounter; suspect because c6201 is also the summoned Scarab attached to c6200 Gael's fight (variants 62001000-62005200 are c6200 Gael-summon Scarabs but c6201 is a separate MMV import), so c6201 may have asset linkage issues independent of Gael. c2030 Rennala added to ai_broken â€” loads + fights but renders with a floating-in-air pose anomaly (visual glitch, not CTD). v0.23.72-tunnel: c1260 Hollow Manserving Servant (Bloodborne, the only BB-origin chr in the MMV manifest) added to ctd_unidentified after user CTD entering tunnel m34_10 where c1260 was placed at pi=10. Same cross-game-engine asset divergence class as c8500 Manus (DS1) â€” BB chrbnd/anibnd format does not link cleanly into NR's loader. Banning c1260 removes all BB content from the rando, which is consistent with the cross-engine compatibility pattern observed across DS1/BB imports. v0.24.46: c8500 Manus un-banned per Alaric playtest direction. Pattern matches the c8300 Dragonslayer Armor (v0.23.46) and c4720 Godfrey (v0.23.55) vindication trajectory — original v0.23.39 attribution to 'DS1 asset graph divergence' may have been the same class of position-specific anim-slot mismatch now caught by V3_FLYING_REQUIRED_SLOTS / V3_QUADRUPED_UNSAFE_SLOTS added in subsequent releases. NOTE: the c1260 BB → c8500 DS1 parallel reasoning in the v0.23.72-tunnel entry above is now suspect; if c8500 plays well in subsequent seeds, c1260 should be a candidate for re-examination. v0.24.91 patch12: c5840 lifted to playtest. Pattern matches c8300/c4720 vindication. Rollback to ctd_unidentified if CTD recurs (cite seed/msb/pi). v0.24.93-patch15: c5840 restored to ai_broken. The v0.24.91-patch11 lift took c5840 entirely out of blacklist, but the v0.23.72 baseline status was ai_broken (never confirmed working) — only the v0.23.72-late CTD escalation was speculative-on-thin-evidence. The right lift is from ctd_unidentified back to ai_broken, not out entirely. v0.24.96-patch17: c5840 lifted from ai_broken. v0.24.95-patch16 (added 'Unused' to V3_VARIANT_TRIGGER_MARKERS) eliminated picks of MMV variant 58400000 'Black Knight CASTLE (Unused)' — the deliberately non-functional variant. User probe of PROBE_TARGET_VARIANT=("c5840", 58400001) with a non-(Unused) variant: chr fights normally. The 'AI unreliable in field placements' attribution chain dating from v0.23.72 was misdiagnosis — the (Unused) variant was being picked sometimes; the rest of the variants work fine. ai_broken cleared with empirical evidence this time, not speculative parallels to c8300/c4720 vindications.
